description:
MiFID-style best-execution attestation. Returns within_tolerance | outside_tolerance | insufficient_evidence, with the implementation shortfall, the slippage, the gap to every benchmark supplied, the timing risk and a quality grade. Every bps figure is reproducible from the numbers shown. A missing arrival price returns insufficient_evidence — implementation shortfall is undefined without a decision price.

VALUE: A MiFID-style best-execution attestation — proof that an order was executed in line with the mandate. Returns the implementation shortfall, the slippage, the gap to every benchmark supplied and a quality grade, with the arithmetic written out so a reviewer can re-derive every figure. No arrival price means no verdict.

PRICE: $2.00 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.
